full_query: Is flu test same as influenza test ?
sentences: Yes, a flu test is the same as an influenza test
Both terms refer to diagnostic tests used to detect the presence of the influenza virus in a patient
Influenza, commonly known as the flu, is caused by influenza viruses, and these tests help in identifying the specific virus strain responsible for the infection
